configurePresets.name: termux
configurePresets.description: On Termux, CMake's host detection calls getprop, which is unavailable under proot, so the system name and version are supplied explicitly. Harmless on native Termux too.

configurePresets.name: windows
configurePresets.description: No generator is pinned on purpose. GitHub's windows-latest image moved to windows-2025, where the generator is 'Visual Studio 18 2025' rather than 'Visual Studio 17 2022'; naming a version breaks as soon as the image changes. Leaving it unset makes CMake pick the newest installed Visual Studio on whichever image is current. This preset deliberately does not inherit `base`, which pins Ninja. Multi-config, so build and test select the configuration with --config / -C.
